annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence - The consequences of artificial intelligence on the (digital) single market, production, consumption, employment and society (own-initiative opinion)
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence - The consequences of artificial intelligence on the (digital) single market, production, consumption, employment and society (own-initiative opinion)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Economic and Social Committee (EESC); Rapporteur: Muller, C.
annotation.summary_en: This is the EESC landing page for its own-initiative opinion INT/806 on AI, adopted on 31 May 2017 with Catelijne Muller as rapporteur. The page summary says AI offers great potential but also carries risks in labour, safety, privacy, ethics and skills. It calls for a broad approach that covers AI's effects on society as a whole. The full opinion is linked as downloads only.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI offers potential to improve lives, grow the economy and address health, climate and security challenges
AI carries risks in labour, safety, privacy, ethics and skills
A broad societal approach covering AI's good and bad effects is crucial
